name: Naneghat & Jivdhan Fort
tagline: A 2,000-year-old trade route, ancient inscriptions, and a wind-driven 'reverse waterfall'
seoTitle: Naneghat Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Naneghat and Jivdhan Fort near Junnar — the ancient Satavahana trade route, monsoon 'reverse waterfall', safety, and packing.

seasons.label: Jun – Sep
seasons.sub: Monsoon — the famous reverse-waterfall wind effect

seasons.label: Oct – Feb
seasons.sub: Clear, good for the historical cave inscriptions

routeOptions.name: Naneghat pass only
routeOptions.notes: Visits the ancient toll-collection cave and Brahmi inscriptions; a straightforward moderate day trek.

routeOptions.name: Naneghat + Jivdhan Fort
routeOptions.notes: Adds the Jivdhan Fort climb as a range extension — more committing, better for experienced trekkers.

safety.intro: Naneghat's main hazard is the strong monsoon wind at the pass itself — genuinely strong enough to affect footing near edges.

alerts.title: Strong gusting wind at the pass in monsoon
alerts.body: The 'reverse waterfall' effect exists because wind is genuinely powerful here. Keep back from ledges when gusts pick up.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Check monsoon road conditions to the Junnar-side trailhead — can get muddy
This is a historically significant site — respect the ancient inscriptions and toll-pot structure

cards.title: On the trail
items: Wind at the pass can be strong enough to unbalance you near edges
The stone steps near the caves get slippery in rain

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: Less trafficked than Lonavala-area forts — let someone know your plan
Combine with a group day-trip if possible given the more remote trailhead

items.name: Windproof layer — the pass is genuinely windy
Camera for the inscriptions and toll-pot cave
